artifactSettingsDescription: Run project HTML on a separate hostname. Scripts can use the files beside the document and their own mocked or real services.
artifactPublicHint: Leave blank to disable hosted access. Use HTTPS and route this hostname to the artifact listener below. Artifact bytes travel outside YA’s encrypted relay connection.

artifactDeleteOnExpiryHint: Applies to artifacts YA itself produces, such as captures: their directory is removed when the link expires or is revoked. Previewing a file you already had never deletes anything. Only the files present when the link was created are removed, the directory goes only if it is then empty, and files Git tracks are left where they are. A checkout's own root, a home directory or anything under it, and YA's own state are never treated as artifact directories.
appsSettingsAutosave: Text fields save when you leave them. Toggles and sliders save when changed.
artifactLocked: Artifact settings are controlled at launch.
artifactSeparateHost: Use a different hostname from YA for artifacts.
artifactVhostPublicRootHint: Leave blank for name.localhost only. Setting example.com means you intend to public-tunnel *.example.com to YA’s configured app-service port ({port}). Configure wildcard DNS and HTTPS in your tunnel, preserving the original Host header. This field enables hostname routing; it does not create the tunnel or add access protection.
artifactAlwaysRewriteVhostLinksHint: Normally YA rewrites configured app links only in sessions opened through a public relay page. Enable this to rewrite them on direct and localhost YA pages too. Private app links include their app-scoped access token.

A file answers at / together with everything it links to, followed through linked pages and CSS, even outside its folder; Markdown opens rendered, with ?raw for its text. A directory serves its files, with index.html for folders. Names are first come, first served across every vhost and project app address.

appearanceSessionLoadingProgressDescript: Show detailed loading phases for large sessions and reveal long transcripts after a progress bar reaches 100%.
appearanceStableToolPreviewDescription: Keep completed tool previews pre-rendered so long sessions do not jump while scrolling. Disable if large sessions feel slower.
appearanceInlineImagesDescription: Start linked image and video previews expanded in transcripts and markdown. Disable to keep media links compact until individually expanded.
appearanceImageGalleriesDescription: Enable a compact gallery for assistant turns with two or more images. It opens automatically when inline media starts expanded, or from the Gallery action beside the image links.
appearanceRecentProjectPathLinksDescript: Turn a bare filename into a file link when an earlier loaded transcript item linked a full path with the same basename.
appearanceQuoteReplyButtonsDescription: Choose between one block-level reply button, per-paragraph buttons on hover, or per-paragraph buttons always shown.
appearanceSelectionQuoteActionDescriptio: Show the green > circle beside a text selection. This is separate from the paragraph reply-button setting above.
appearanceSelectionTextCopyActionDescrip: Show the neutral copy circle for the selected visible text. The complete selection menu remains available on right-click.
appearanceSelectionSourceCopyActionDescr: Show the blue copy circle when selected rendered text has Markdown formatting to preserve. Plain messages and raw source omit it. On mobile it appears above quote reply. Ordinary Copy and Ctrl/Cmd+C copy visible text.
appearanceSelectionRichCopyActionDescrip: Show the purple Aa circle for semantic HTML plus visible plain text, without viewer presentation styles.
appearanceSelectionNewSessionActionDescr: Show the green + circle that opens a same-project new-session composer with the selection quoted. File selections include a reliable file:line citation when available.
appearanceFunPhrasesDescription: Show playful status messages while waiting for responses. Disable to show only "Thinking..."
appearanceFloatingActionButtonDescriptio: Show the quick new-session button on wide screens.
appearanceSidebarDuplicateHidingDescript: Group duplicate recent and older sidebar rows behind a hidden count. Disable to show every duplicate session.
appearanceProjectCodeNamesDescription: Use editable short project codes in browser tab titles and sidebar session rows. Full project names with ordinary ellipsis are used when this is off.
appearanceTabTitleActivityTitle: Show Session Activity in Tab Title
appearanceTabTitleActivityDescription: Animate the browser tab title while sessions are working.
appearanceProjectCodeNameActivityPulseTi: Pulse Project Code for Tab Activity
appearanceProjectCodeNameActivityPulseDe: When short project codes and tab-title activity are enabled, pulse the project code using Mathematical Bold instead of the circle indicator.
appearanceConnectionBarsDescription: Show colored status bars for relay and session connections (green/orange/red).
performanceSectionDescription: Tune rendering, route retention, and optional host resource monitoring.
performanceHostProcessObservabilityDescr: Show recent CPU, memory, and age in Agents, including independently launched agent processes. Sampling runs only while Agents is open. Command lines and environment variables are never sent to the browser.
performanceKeepRecentSessionMountedDescr: Keep the most recently viewed session mounted briefly after leaving it so returning can be instant. Disable to reduce memory use.
performanceActiveWindowTrimDescription: Automatically unload older transcript messages while following the live tail to limit memory growth. Full history remains available with Load older.
performanceInitialHistoryDescription: Maximum number of recent compaction boundaries to load when opening or reconnecting. Older history remains available with Load older.
performanceReverseSearchPageLimitDescrip: Maximum older-history pages one active search shortcut or Up action may load while looking for the next match. A page is one bounded server response, normally covering at most two compaction boundaries.
performanceTranscriptCacheDescription: Memory budget for keeping recent session transcripts in memory so returning is fast. Off forces fresh loads.
performanceTranscriptCacheEquivalentLast: ≈ {count} sessions the size of your last viewed ({size} MB)
performanceTranscriptCacheCurrentUsage: Current memory: {warmSize} MB warm cache, {liveSize} MB live sessions
performanceTranscriptCacheTtlDescription: How long an unvisited cached transcript stays in memory before it is freed.

appearanceToolbarThinkingDescription: Show the thinking mode quick toggle.
appearanceToolbarConversationViewDescrip: Show a chat button that switches between the full activity transcript and a condensed conversation.

sessionExternalWarning: External session active — enter messages at your own risk!
sessionExternalRiskIntro: Another program — often an agent you started elsewhere (Claude, Codex, or Gemini in a terminal, an IDE extension, or another tool) — is currently writing to this conversation's transcript. Each session is a single file on disk, and if you also send from here, two programs append to that one file at once without coordinating. The likely effects:
sessionExternalRiskUnseenLead: The other program may not see your messages.
sessionExternalRiskUnseenBody: A terminal or IDE session keeps the conversation in its own memory and generally won't reload the transcript when this app appends to it, so turns you add here can stay invisible there — both on screen and in the context it sends to the model next.
sessionExternalRiskForkLead: The conversation can quietly split in two.
sessionExternalRiskForkBody: A transcript is a tree of turns, each pointing back to one earlier turn. If the other program continues from the turn it remembers while this app continues from the latest turn on disk, you end up with two branches in one file, and only one is treated as the live tip.
sessionExternalRiskLostLead: Work on the side branch can be lost on the next resume.
sessionExternalRiskLostBody: When the session is resumed later, the model's context is rebuilt by walking back from the chosen tip, so anything on the branch that wasn't chosen — even finished work you already read — may simply be gone afterward, with no error.
sessionExternalRiskCaveat: These are the most likely outcomes, not a guarantee. The exact effects depend on what the other program is and how it manages the session, and there may be others — for instance, if both programs write at the same instant, the shared transcript file itself could be left inconsistent. The safe move is to drive a session from one place at a time: close the other program, or treat this view as read-only until the warning clears.
sessionPendingElsewhereWarning: This session may be waiting for input in another process (VS Code, CLI). Check there before sending a message.
pendingToolRiskIntro: This session's transcript ends on a tool call with no result, and no live process is detected driving it. Another program (a terminal or IDE) may still be running the call or be parked at a prompt — or it may have exited and left the call dangling. YA can't tell which. The likely effects of sending from here:
pendingToolRiskUnblockBody: If the other program is parked at a prompt, that prompt lives in its own UI, not as a message in this transcript, so a message from here does not resolve it.
pendingToolRiskForkBody: Sending appends onto a turn whose tool call is unfinished; when the other program resumes from the call it remembers, the histories split into two branches and a later resume keeps only one.
pendingToolRiskDiscardLead: If that program already exited, the call is discarded.
pendingToolRiskDiscardBody: Resuming a transcript whose last step is an unanswered tool call forces the provider to drop or synthesize a result, losing whatever that run was doing.
pendingToolRiskCaveat: YA cannot tell a program parked at a prompt from one that has exited — both leave the same unfinished tool call on disk — so this is a hedge, not a certainty. The safe move is to check the other program first.

providersSectionDescription: Desktop application presence, launchable runtimes, and authentication are detected separately.
providersSubagentMaxDepthDescription: Maximum subagent nesting depth for newly started or resumed provider processes. 0 disables subagents; leave the number empty or choose Provider default to add no YA limit.
providersSubagentMaxDepthCoverage: Applies to Claude, Claude Gateway, Claude Ollama, Codex V1 multi-agent threads, and Grok. Codex V2 ignores this setting. Grok already hard-caps nesting at 1; 0 disables Grok subagents via GROK_SUBAGENTS. An explicit CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_SUBAGENT_SPAWN_DEPTH or GROK_SUBAGENTS in YA's environment takes precedence.
providersIdleReapHoursDescription: How long YA keeps an eligible idle provider process after that session's last viewer closes and no feature retains it. Each idle harness holds roughly 80-215 MiB.
providersIdleReapHoursAria: Hours before an eligible idle provider process may be reaped
providersIdleReapNeverHint: -1 disables this cleanup. It never ends a running turn or a provider process waiting for user or provider input.
providersLongContextEffortWarningTitle: Warn before effort changes on long contexts
providersLongContextEffortWarningDescrip: For each checked provider, changing effort mid-session on a session whose last request was at least this many tokens asks first, because the effort is part of the system prompt and the change re-reads the cached context. The dialog offers a fork at the new effort instead. Codex GPT-6 Astra's in-place effort update is not usable through YA yet, so Astra warns too. Default on for Claude and Codex at 5,000 tokens.
providersLongContextEffortWarningThresho: 0 warns on every effort change. The slider stops at 500,000; type a larger number for more.
providersLongContextEffortWarningSaveErr: Failed to save the long-context effort warning setting
instructionRestorationDescription: Restore essential instructions from matching files this session previously read, unless it has already reread them. A recursive reread also satisfies the files it includes. Off by default for every provider.
instructionRestorationBoundary: Paths are resolved through symlinks in the session filesystem. Only matches inside this prefix qualify. Local, unsandboxed sessions only; this setting grants no extra filesystem access.
instructionRestorationCompanion: YA inserts <topic>.mandatory-reread.md after the delay. Reads covering at least 80% are accepted to avoid redundant rereads. Zero restores at the first idle boundary.
instructionRestorationPreviewLimit: Preview limited to 100 matches or 2,000 directory entries. Only files actually read by a session are restored.
providersPostCompactReplayDescription: When enabled for a provider, YA injects a hidden user turn after compaction settles and the session is idle. The turn ends with “continue.” An optional replay quotes the last N user/assistant prose turns as before-compaction activity, with their original roles. Start at 0 if a provider stops with unfinished work after compaction. Off by default: many providers already continue from their own compact summary, so this is often redundant. Codex in particular often keeps working through compaction.
providersPostCompactReplayCountAria: Number of recent user and assistant prose turns to replay after compaction
providersPostCompactReplayCountHint: 0 sends only “continue.” Greater than 0 also copies those turns.
providersPostCompactReplaySaveError: Failed to save post-compact continuation setting
providersRecapDefaultsDescription: Default recap mode and shared helper model for new sessions.
providersPromptSuggestionDefaultsDescrip: Default next-turn suggestion mode for new sessions.
providersLoginHint: {provider} can be launched, but authentication is not confirmed. You can still start a session; if authentication fails, run this command and retry.
providersApplicationWithoutRuntimeHint: The {provider} desktop application was found, but YA could not validate a provider runtime. Update the application or configure its CLI path, then refresh.
providersClaudeLoginHint: Claude appears installed but not currently authenticated. Reauthenticate with the Claude CLI login flow.
providersClaudeLoginCommandCopyError: Failed to copy Claude login command
providersClaudeAutoCompactDescription: Set one launch-time threshold for every Claude session. This percentage is of Claude Code's own auto-compaction window, can only compact earlier than Claude's default, and only applies where Claude proactively compacts. Set 0 to leave Claude Code unchanged. Existing sessions restart and resume before their next turn.
providersClaudeAutoCompactMirrorDescript: Same Claude-only control as under Providers → Claude. Launch-time override for Claude Code's own auto-compaction window — not YA's per-model Compact context early. Set 0 to leave Claude Code unchanged.
providersClaudeAutoCompactSaveError: Failed to save Claude auto-compaction threshold
providersYaCompactEarlyMirrorDescription: Same per-model control as under Session Defaults (Compact context early). YA may queue /compact at idle when usage crosses this share of the model window. Edits the default Claude model ({model}).
providersClaudeGatewayDescription: Add an Anthropic-compatible endpoint as a separate Claude provider. Empty leaves it off.
providersClaudeGatewayStartCommandHint: Optional. Runs through Bash on the YA server host only when the configured endpoint is loopback and its TCP port has no listener. Keep the gateway in the foreground so YA can stop it on shutdown.
providersClaudeGatewayIsolationHint: Applied only to YA sessions launched through Claude Gateway. Regular Claude sessions and manual Claude TUIs keep their current routing.
providersGatewayServicesDescription: Endpoints that serve models over an OpenAI- or Anthropic-compatible API. Claude Gateway offers the models from every enabled service; CodexOSS can use the ones you allow it. Empty leaves both off.
providersGatewayServicesCodexHint: CodexOSS runs a local model through the Codex CLI. Allowing a service lists its models for CodexOSS with no other setup; new services allow it by default. With no service allowed, CodexOSS needs a local server of its own: install Ollama (ollama.com), run `ollama serve`, and pull a model.
providersGatewayServiceShortNameHint: Shown next to a model name so you can tell where it runs. Defaults to the service id.
providersGatewayServiceSizesHint: What you state here wins over whatever the endpoint advertises. Leave both empty to use the advertised sizes, or nothing at all when the endpoint states none.
providersGatewayServiceCommandHint: Optional. Run on the YA server host to start this service when its port has no listener, and to stop it again. Ending the command with "start" says it takes start, status and stop; otherwise YA asks the command which form it accepts, and runs it in the foreground when it is the server itself.
providersGatewayServiceCommandRemoteHint: Only a localhost endpoint can be started or stopped by YA.
providersGatewayServiceAutoStopAfterAria: Idle seconds before stopping the service
providersGatewayServiceAutoStopHint: Asks the command to stop once no session is using this service. A service that waits for its own clients is left to finish; one that ignores the request has its listener stopped a while later.
providersGatewayServiceMaxModelsAria: Maximum models kept from this service
providersGatewayServiceEffortHint: Effort levels this service's models offer. Tick only levels the model treats differently; two ticks that reach the same behavior make two menu entries that do the same thing.
providersGatewayServiceMoveUp: Move this service earlier in the list
providersGatewayServiceMoveDown: Move this service later in the list
providersGatewayServiceOrderHint: New Session lists models in this order, for both Claude Gateway and CodexOSS, so put the service you pick from most often first. The default service is used when nothing names one; it does not jump the list.
providersGatewayServiceEffortDetectionTi: Ask endpoints which thinking efforts they accept
providersGatewayServiceEffortDetectionDe: Asks each service what its reasoning-effort field accepts, once, and offers the answer. A service set to state its own levels is never asked.
providersGatewayServiceEffortDetectNoMod: This endpoint lists no models to ask about.
providersGatewayServiceEffortDetectUndes: This endpoint does not say which efforts it accepts.
providersGatewayServicePendingBlur: Saves when you leave the field
providersGatewayServiceExportTitle: Make these services usable from the terminal
providersGatewayServiceExportDescription: Writes one file per service for the Claude and Codex CLIs, so the same models can be selected outside YA. YA owns those files and rewrites them whenever the services change; your own ~/.claude/settings.json and ~/.codex/config.toml are never read or edited. pi has no such per-launch file, so its ~/.pi/agent/models.json instead gains one ya-<service> provider per service, leaving everything else in it alone and keeping a one-time .ya-backup copy. Turning this off deletes what YA wrote and withdraws the pi providers.
providersGatewayServiceCliLabel: Run this service from a terminal:
providersClaudeGatewayDisableAgentDescri: Pass Claude Code a deny rule for the Agent tool in Claude Gateway sessions, preventing built-in and custom subagent delegation. Takes effect when a Gateway process starts or resumes; regular Claude is unchanged. Turning this off stops YA from adding the rule, but other Claude settings may still deny the tool.
providersClaudeGatewayDisablePlanModeDes: Remove EnterPlanMode and ExitPlanMode from Claude Gateway model context while leaving TaskCreate and other task-tracking tools available. Takes effect when a Gateway process starts or resumes; already-running Gateway processes must restart or resume. Regular Claude is unchanged. Turning this off stops YA from removing the plan-mode tools.
providersClaudeOllamaDeprecationNotice: Use Claude Gateway instead. ClaudeOllama will be removed in a future release.
providersAdditionalModelsDescription: Opt previous or custom model IDs into Claude model pickers. Nothing is enabled by default.
providersAdditionalModelsEditorDescripti: Enabled entries appear separately from the primary model list. Account access is checked only when you use a model.
providersAdditionalModelsUnlistedDescrip: Previously enabled; no longer maintained by this server
providersAdditionalModelsCustomHint: Add an exact provider model ID. Saving it does not guarantee that your account can use it.
providersAdditionalModelsInvalidId: Enter an exact model ID without spaces.
modelSelectionUnavailable: Saved or current selection; not currently enabled
providersCodexReasoningSummaryDescriptio: Used when a Codex session starts, resumes, or forks. Automatic lets Codex choose; Off disables summaries. Active sessions keep their current mode, and Detailed is not supported by every model.
providersCodexPlanToolDescription: Allows structured Codex plans to appear as checklists. Enabled permits but does not force them; Disabled leaves prose planning available. Takes effect on the next start, resume, or fork.
providersCodexCyberAccessDescription: Requests a security research program on every Codex turn. The default lets Codex choose, as its own terminal app does. Named programs need an already-enrolled ChatGPT account; picking one does not grant access.
providersCodexUpdateUpToDate: Codex CLI {version} is up to date
providersModelsRefreshFailed: Could not refresh provider models. Try again.
providersCodexUpdateManualInstallHint: This Codex install was not installed with npm, so YA cannot update it automatically. Update it with ChatGPT or your package manager, then restart Yep Anywhere.
codexUpdateProgress: Updating Codex CLI now. This dialog stays open so you can verify the command output.
codexUpdateManualInstallHint: This Codex install was not installed with npm, so Yep Anywhere cannot update it automatically. Update it with ChatGPT or your package manager, then restart Yep Anywhere.
speechSettingsDescription: Choose the speech-to-text backend YA uses for dictation in every session.
speechSettingsVoiceInputDescription: Enable YA microphone controls on this browser when the server allows voice input.
speechSettingsServerDisabled: The server has voice input disabled, so browser controls stay hidden.
speechSettingsBackendDescription: Used by new sessions and active composers unless a future per-session override is added.
speechSettingsNoServerBackends: No server-routed speech backends are currently advertised; browser-native recognition remains available when supported.
speechSettingsUnspokenPunctuationDescrip: Browser-native STT only. Let supported browsers infer periods, commas, and question marks from pauses and prosody. Off by default because brief thinking pauses can produce extra periods.
speechSettingsStreamingRelayUnavailable: Streaming speech controls are unavailable over relay; this browser uses batch transcription here.
speechSettingsXaiKeyDescription: Optional. Stored in this browser only and not sent to YA. Direct Grok STT uses it first; if empty, it asks this YA server for a short-lived secret or borrowed key only when transcription starts.
speechSettingsWhisperModelDescription: Optimized CPU inference; GPU acceleration available when configured. Recommended only when no GPU is available. It can invent text during silence or non-speech audio. Server default uses Distil large v3.5 unless configured otherwise.
speechBackendSetupWhisperPerformance: Optimized CPU inference; GPU acceleration available when configured.
speechBackendSetupWhisperGpuHelp: Saved on this server. Reloads Whisper after active dictation; no YA restart needed.
speechBackendSetupModelAdvice: Whisper is recommended only when no GPU is available. Choose Grok STT for Smart Turn or streaming in YA. Grok reports 6.90% WER on xAI's separate commercial-domain evaluation. English WER: lower is better; scores from different evaluations cannot be ranked together. Unavailable means no score in this snapshot.
speechBackendSetupStreamingAdvice: NeMo Parakeet currently uses batch recognition in YA: 5.91% WER on NVIDIA's evaluation. The model's streaming mode trades accuracy for latency: 6.14% at 2.08 s, 8.44% at 160 ms. Streaming support in YA is planned.
speechSettingsParakeetModelDescription: Model id sent with YA Parakeet or NeMo transcription requests from this browser.
speechSettingsParakeetModelHint: Server default uses Unified English 0.6B on NeMo and an HF conversion of TDT v2 English on updated Transformers backends, unless configured otherwise. V3 remains available for multilingual use. NeMo requires a heavier, separate software installation. YA currently uses batch transcription.
speechSettingsSmartTurnDescription: Send, cancel, or wait after a dictated pause when the selected STT backend supports it.
speechSettingsSmartTurnUnavailable: {backend} does not advertise Smart Turn controls.
speechSettingsKeepMicWarmDescription: Keep this browser's microphone stream ready while this tab is visible between server-routed dictations so repeated starts skip the browser's device cold-open. The browser may show the mic indicator while the idle stream is held; no audio is sent between dictations. On phones and tablets, the on-screen keyboard or its voice-input button may be unavailable while YA holds the microphone.
speechSettingsReducePlaybackDescription: Mute audio played by YA and request browser echo cancellation while listening. Chrome on Android can use its communication audio path; other apps may not honor ducking.
speechSettingsFollowUpListenDescription: After a Smart Turn send, listen for another utterance for this long. Each speech-triggered send restarts the window; 0 turns follow-up listening off.
speechSettingsMessagePrefixDescription: Prepends the selected label to speech-triggered messages so the agent knows the text may contain transcription errors. Off sends your text unchanged.
speechSettingsAsrAttributionDescription: A manual Send, Steer, Queue, or Project Queue within this time after finalized speech receives {prefix}. A later manual delivery does not. 0 disables the window.
speechSettingsAsrAttributionDisabledDesc: Choose a speech message prefix to enable rapid manual-delivery attribution.
speechBackendSetupLiveDescription: Enable a backend to save it on this YA server and validate it now. No restart is needed to add a backend. relayLoginLimitedUsernamePlaceholder: Leave blank for the server's owner
relayLoginLimitedUsernameHint: Experimental. Enter your limited-user name if the server owner created an account for you; otherwise leave blank.
advancedLimitedUsersDescription: Create password-protected accounts for trusted family or collaborators and grant them selected projects. This preview helps prevent accidental access; it is not hardened isolation for hostile or untrusted users. Their agent sessions always run sandboxed.
usersTrustWarning: Use limited users only with people you trust. Do not rely on this preview as a security boundary between mutually untrusted users.
hostOfflineHintResumeRejected: Sign in again to establish a new session with this server.
hostOfflineMessageResumeRejected: The server rejected the saved session. Sign in again to reconnect.
hostOfflineMessageResumeTimeout: The session resume request timed out. Your saved session has been kept so we can try again.
hostOfflineMessageResumeVerification: The server response could not be verified. Automatic recovery has stopped; your saved session has been kept.
hostOfflineHintResumeVerification: Check the server and connection details before trying to sign in again.
routerLaunchUnsupported: Router sessions require this server, a local native provider, and no YA sandbox.
routerQueueUnsupported: Start router sessions directly. Project queue support is not available yet.
routerRenewal: Renewal: {state}. Successful routing does not verify renewal.
routerReasoningDefault: Routed sessions start with the provider’s default reasoning settings.
routerDescription: Use an enrolled subscription account through a local router. Account selection is manual; sessions keep their account.
routerUnavailable: Router unavailable. Check the local service and connection.
routerStatusUnknown: Router status could not be checked
routerReady: Router reachable. Granted accounts were checked just now.
routerLegacyStatus: Pairing is saved. Use Check status to refresh account availability.
routerRevocationHelp: Start AAR, then finish disconnecting. New routed launches are blocked. Existing workers may still have access until AAR confirms revocation.
routerPairingHelp: Retry the connection to finish the saved pairing. Existing account grants will not be replaced.
routerDisconnectedHelp: Connect in Settings → Providers to start new routed sessions. Sessions from an earlier pairing cannot move to a new pairing.
routerPendingCleanupHelp: YA stopped these launches, but AAR has not confirmed their credentials were revoked. Retry cleanup when AAR is reachable; no new session will be started.
routerNoAccounts: No granted accounts. Enroll and enable accounts in AAR, then disconnect and pair again for new sessions.
routerAccountDisabled: Disabled in AAR. Re-enable this account there to resume its pinned sessions, or select an available account for a new session.
routerNoAvailableAccounts: No enabled router accounts for this provider. Check AAR and refresh; the selected account will not be changed automatically.
routerUsageUnavailable: Usage is unavailable. This does not establish whether inference is available.
routerPoolManagedByRouter: Manage accounts, pools and access grants in Agent Auth Router. After access is granted, reload this overview to see your pools.
routerPoolOverviewHelp: Bars show remaining quota for each account. Refresh reads current quota and model information; opening this overview does not contact providers.
routerPoolMostRemainingHelp: Prefer the greatest remaining percentage in the tightest applicable window, while spreading simultaneous starts.
routerPoolPolicyUpgrade: Update YA and AAR for this policy
routerPoolAdmissionHelp: Starting a session refreshes stale quota and model evidence. Existing sessions keep their account. This preview uses cached observations.
routerPoolEditWarning: Removing an account blocks its existing pool sessions. Deleting the pool blocks all its sessions. Changing the policy affects new sessions only.
routerPoolDelete: Delete pool and block its sessions
routerPoolRevisionHelp: If another client changes this pool, reload the overview and reopen the editor before saving.
routerPoolEmpty: No pools yet. Create one to group accounts and choose a session policy.
routerPoolRefreshFailed: Refresh failed. Previous usage is retained and is not current eligibility evidence.
routerPoolNone: No pool — direct or manual account
routerPoolLaunchHelp: The selected account is pinned for this session. Round robin requires fresh quota and model information; use Refresh for each account below.
routerPoolScopeUnknown: Quota scope is unknown — automatic selection unavailable
routerPoolCooldown: Provider cooldown — refresh after retry period
routerPoolAuthUnavailable: Provider rejected access — check CLI login and refresh
routerDiscoveryFailed: Router unavailable. Start AAR and retry.
routerSelectionUnavailable: This pool cannot run the selected model and thinking level.
